scope: Kurs project-owned materials only, not vendor assets

issues.problem: Interior normal generator negates PNG row derivative in green; OpenGL +Y requires positive row derivative.
issues.fix: Regenerate physical +Y normals and verify analytic ramp.

issues.problem: Visible coarse weave/checker at close range, mixed scale conventions and non-periodic interior resize noise.
issues.fix: 2 mm subtle yarn relief; periodic multiscale fields; one physical UV specification.

issues.problem: Opaque PBR has only Base/Normal/packed mask; no exchange roughness/metallic/cavity/height maps.
issues.fix: Independent named scalar maps and physical 16-bit height; conservative cavity AO.

issues.problem: Ceramic pattern repeats 4x4 tiles every 2 m; old 1K detail is lost near the player.
issues.fix: 4K 8 m hero pattern with 16x16 0.5 m tiles and per-tile color/grime.

issues.problem: Old painted blue uses metallic .05 plus rust .48; oxide and paint are dielectrics.
issues.fix: Separate bare metal from corrosion/coating; metallic zero for paint, cloth, tile, wood.

issues.problem: Importer hard-caps all textures at 1024; most prop textures only 512.
issues.fix: Manifest-controlled 1K/2K/4K cap with mipmaps; preserve all existing texture GUIDs.
